Chapter 944: Chapter 9: The Twelve Layers Of Other Races (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 944: Chapter 9: The Twelve Layers of Other Races (Please Subscribe)

The numerous weapons, treasures, and precious artifacts left by the peak Dominator, ‘Cang Weiyang’, greatly benefited Lin Yuan.

“In fact, this cave dwelling itself is also a precious treasure. It may not be anything special for a Dominator, but within the universe, it is the strongest war machine that acts without any inhibitions. Even those at the twelfth layer’s ultimate level can do nothing about it.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

At least under the control of an owner, even if dozens of those at the twelfth layer’s ultimate level join forces, they cannot shake it.

Of course, to activate such a massive object, the energy consumption would be terrifying, and a common Path Splitting Realm would definitely not be able to withstand it.

“Send this cave dwelling and the gains back to the universe immediately.” Lin Yuan stepped out of the cave dwelling and appeared in the Chaos Void. With a thought, he once again split off another incarnation.

Immediately under Lin Yuan’s control, the island of thousands of miles in radius quickly shrank to the size of a palm and fell into the hands of the newly split incarnation.

The Chaos Void was fraught with peril, and this incarnation that Lin Yuan sent out was prepared to disperse at any moment.

Thus.

Having gained something, he saw to it that it should be sent back quickly.

Not to send it back, what if he encountered danger and the incarnation perished, wouldn’t all these treasures be lost?

The treasures left by the peak Dominator ‘Cang Weiyang’ are enough to make the ordinary Dominators envious; for Lin Yuan, who just started exploring the Chaos Void, it is indeed the first ‘Gold’.

“Swoosh.”

Under Lin Yuan’s gaze, that incarnation quickly disappeared, heading back the way it came, rapidly approaching their home universe.

“Next, continue exploring.”

Lin Yuan was enthusiastic. For him at the moment, any little gain from the Chaos Void was satisfying, as it was his first exploration.

…

“Senior Cang Weiyang indeed left me a map of the Chaos Void, but right now without any specific reference points, the map won’t mean much.”

Lin Yuan thought, “First, find the nearest Chaos Continent, and with this Chaos Continent as a reference point, I can also know what’s nearby.”

The Chaos Void map comes in two types: one is public, and the other is private.

The latter is the map personally explored by each twelfth-layer powerhouse, not disclosed to the public, marked with many opportunities.

The map left by Cang Weiyang is a private map.

And the Chaos Continent… it is where many lives converge within the Chaos Void. Most Chaos Continents are formed later, created by Chaos Realm powerhouses as their own territories.

There is strict order within the Chaos Continent, because only with order can it attract a continuous influx of powerhouses; without order, what difference would there be from the Chaos Void?

“As long as I determine which the nearest Chaos Continent is, the map left by Senior Cang Weiyang becomes useful.”

Lin Yuan randomly chose a direction and quickly traveled through the void.

Both Demon Jade Tower and Profound Xuanhuang have left Lin Yuan maps of the Chaos Void.

But both of these existed since ancient times; even though the maps left behind far exceed the detail of Cang Weiyang’s by many folds, they still do not hold much reference value.

As cosmic eras pass by, even Chaos Continents governed by Chaos Realm powerhouses have their day of collapse; the regions marked on the map might not even exist now.

Furthermore, the Chaos Void is too vast; even someone as strong as a Chaos Great Saint cannot explore it entirely. Even if the maps of Chaos Void left by Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master are still effective, whether they have markings of nearby areas is still questionable.

Lin Yuan has seen the images of 33,333 Xuanhuang Secret Realms created by Xuanhuang; it was practically random development, and even Xuanhuang himself might not know the locations of each Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Moyu Tower Master likely was similar.

As a member of the Demon Jade Tower, Lin Yuan could vaguely sense the approximate location of the Demon Jade Space in the Chaos Void, but it was only vague; except for the direction, he was unclear about the distance.

Compared to these two Chaos Great Saints, the map left by Cang Weiyang turned out to be the most useful because Senior Cang Weiyang was the weakest and even if he perished, his cave dwelling wouldn’t have gone far.

And based on the traces of time passage marks on the cave dwelling, Lin Yuan judged that the uncontrolled time won’t be too long, roughly two to three cosmic eras.

Two to three cosmic eras… for twelfth-layer powerhouses in the Chaos Void, it’s not considered too long.

…

Cosmic Starry Skies.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with the 98 secret techniques left by Cang Weiyang emerging in his mind.

As of now, Lin Yuan has reached the pinnacle of the eleventh layer, a true pinnacle. If not for his inner world still transforming, he would probably be preparing to break through to the ultimate.

Therefore, Lin Yuan was quite free lately. Even the vast laws of the Main Universe and the Chaos Void could still help him, but his life level limited Lin Yuan’s advancement.

Merely at the life level of the eleventh layer, even with an Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he could not elevate his space-time comprehension to the Eighth Realm, nor elevate the Chaos Rule to the Second Realm.

However, the newly acquired 98 secret techniques were quite a surprise for Lin Yuan. Secret techniques are not evolutionary pathways, and their cultivation requirements are not strict.

“Of the 98 Dominator-level secret techniques, six are suitable for me.”

Lin Yuan thought that most of the secret techniques required the Path Splitting Realm for cultivation; only six could be practiced at the eleventh layer.

Of these six secret techniques, three are offensive techniques, one is a defensive technique, and the remaining two are supportive techniques.

Basically, all could have a significant effect on the current Lin Yuan.
